review_text: Food alone is S tier! No wonder people kept on recommending this cafe. I ordered Kimchi Rice w/ Beef Tenderlion cubes and my friend ordered Beef Quesadilla, both were sooo good. The portion served were worth the price. We both ordered their spanish latte, by the time we ordered the beans that they were using had 80/20 ratio (which were the perfect balance of sweetness and bitterness, g lamian jud mig maayo sa ilang kape ug food diri HAHAAHAHA) Anyways for service and atmosphere, service alone was understandable since we came in the cafe with loads of people. Also salute to the staff last night (DVO had a slight earthquake) they responded well upon guiding the customers for their safety. Staff were so calm and collective. Atmosphere was okay, we came there and people were like by group (they were with their friends like more than group of 3.) It was a little bit noisy and I found the cafe more of a catching up setting with friends rather than studying. Well if you are planning to study here might as well bring noise cancelling earphones since it can get a bit noisy with the crowd. I also saw some students who were studying in the cafe last night with earphones on, highly suggest to bring a pair if you're planning to study here. Overall I would rate this cafe 4/5 for the food and service, will definitely be coming back here! Thank you so much to the staff last night. Your service and dedication are duly appreciated❤️

The coffee had a smooth and well-balanced flavor, well-brewed with a great depth, a strong coffee. It is so satisfying. You can be awake all night so know your dose. The place is giving 80's with a hint of New gen. Nice interior. Laidback and cozy. We haven't tried their food since we went there at the latest hour before the store closes - will try the food on their menu soon.
The food and service was great. I loved how the place was so relaxing and aesthetically pleasing. Definitely want to go back!

//disclaimer: review by a millennial tita Food and drinks were good for its price point. Serving size is also adequate. I love the interiors and branding. But, parking at this branch is difficult. And the place is really targeted to Gen-Zs. So if you want a quiet place to stay and work, this isn't the first place I'd recommend. But if you want to have convos and catch-ups with friends, come here.

We went there on an afternoon and it was a bit warm just because we were facing the hot sun. Tables were immediately filled up so we had to make do with the tiny table with weird seating near the cashier. We were a little uncomfortable but it was not that bad. Place looks nice and new though, we love the interior. Coffee was okay, nothing grand. Their cookie was delicious. They have more food offerings than most coffee shops which is a good thing. Price points were reasonable. They could improve on the customer service though. Guy on the counter didn't seem happy at all even when I was engaging with him. The other server too, it's like there's a wall between them and the customers. Maybe they had a rough or busy afternoon? I don't know, most places are busy too but they don't treat their customers coldly.

Food is decent, but their mashed potatoes is not well seasoned, a bit bland siya for me. The coffee & matcha are good, though. The place is relaxing & not crowded, since we went on a weekday. The downside lang is that they only accept GCash-to-GCash transactions and don't offer other cashless payment options.

A prudent time to pick up drinks is on an early Sunday afternoon as there is no parking here…. For first-timers the Seasalt Cream and Dirty Matcha lattes were a good call. Small cafe with an open-air space and an additional nicely-decorated second floor. Would really love to try their food next time as it looks enjoyably tempting. I'm eyeing this for a small group get-together soon.

One of the best coffee shops for photoshoots or tambay! The vibe is cool and serene, with the interesting interior and furniture. Good for studying and writing but there is no wifi. Wouldn't recommend this place to read as well as the lights can be harmful to the eyes. The coffee is okay was okay but the cookie was yum!! Overall, would recommend. Must try!

Such a Gen Z vibe - groovy and cozy. Food ive tried so far: truffle fries - large wedges, big serving, generous with their truffle dip, plus everything is made from scratch! brunch toast - quality ham was used! If youre up for a hearty snack, i recommend this mushroom pasta - personally, its a bit greasy because of the olive oil which Im not a fan of, but the mushroom serving was generous and hindi malansa Fave go-to coffee here: Hot mocha. Ive heard their best seller coffee is spanish latte, but since im not a fan of sweet drinks so didnt order one

I visited this place before heading back to Manila and decided to try their coffee. Although I'm not really a coffee drinker, I thought it was quite good. What I truly loved about this spot, though, is its aesthetic—it's beautifully designed and has a unique charm. Next time, I'd love to come back and explore more of their food options.

Will definitely go again next time and love their service and workers. The whole ambiance of the place is just chef's kiss! I love how customers are taught with claygo rather than leaving the job to the service crew. <3
Highly accommodating servers. Minimal menu but sufficient enough to keep our conversations going. Cozy aesthetics with music highly inviting for young people.

Not a fan of the interior of this branch. Dim lighting, awkward table arrangements. Space can get loud if there's a huge group. Note that most of the seats are located at the 2nd floor. Otherwise same old good food with great value for money, and superb service.
Good coffee and food. The baristas were also very welcoming and kind. The interior is very cozy and picture-worthy.

Where urban breezes softly intertwine, Habitat Coffee blooms, a modern design. From sourced beans deep, to fragrant, foamy art, A cozy haven, where warm stories start. A city's pause, in every crafted brew, A gentle comfort, shining fresh and new.
Place looks like an art gallery, which is really nice. I liked the cookie we ordered and the drink too. The staff are friendly and accommodating
I LUVVV THIS PLAAACEEE!! The cashier seemed unfriendly and unwelcoming, they weren't smiling at all.
cute little cafe. loved their spanish latte 🙂 ↔️

I got an Iced Long Black and a revel bar for takeout. I was amused by the decor on the ground floor where the coffee bar was. The Long Black was good enough to sustain me til I got to my destination. Will come back next time to try their other coffees and food.

Love the ambience of this café. I ordered the Beef Bolognese Meatball Pasta 5/5 love that their pasta is perfectly cooked! The Grilled Cheese Sandwich with Tomato Sauce was my fave and the Beef Stroganoff is reallllyyy good. It's a must try! The drinks are also sooo good 10/10 🔥
One of the best coffee shops in Davao. Great ambiance too!
Kind accommodating staff and their upstairs area is great
If you want to step back and recharge your social battery while being productive. Enjoy the good food options and allow the dim lit room cradle you to productivity.
superrrr love love the placeee 🫀🫀. in a coffee scene that is super saturated na, this cafe has its own vibe and taste that sets it apart from the others. will always recommend!! 📌
One of the few coffee shops in Davao City which serves good food and coffee!!
Very good coffee and food. Not expensive
Cozy vibe, good food & coffee!!!
The place is super nice!❤️❤️❤️
Great cafe! 💯
